name: Input Quantization Assist
description: Accessibility input buffer: nudges jump clicks that land 1-2 physics steps off an orb/ring timing window. Toggle with a hotkey.

start-enabled.name: Start Enabled
start-enabled.description: Turn the assist on automatically when the game launches. Useful on devices without a keyboard (the hotkey needs one).

toggle-key.name: Toggle Hotkey
toggle-key.description: Key that switches the assist on and off.

window-frames.name: Window (physics steps)
window-frames.description: How far off a timing window a click may land and still be corrected. 1 or 2 physics steps.

assist-early.name: Assist Early Clicks
assist-early.description: Hold a click that lands just BEFORE an orb/ring window opens until the window opens.

assist-late.name: Assist Late Clicks
assist-late.description: Re-apply a click that lands just AFTER an orb/ring window closed.

show-notifications.name: Show Toggle Notification
show-notifications.description: Show an on-screen message when the assist is toggled.

debug-log.name: Debug Logging
debug-log.description: Write a log line every time a click is adjusted.
